json_proto.name: PDM_OEE_COMMAND_CENTER

queries.sqlText: SELECT am.TURBINE_ID, am.WIND_FARM, SUM(fm.DURATION_HOURS) AS total_downtime_hours FROM PDM_OEE_DB.GOLD.FLEET_METRICS fm JOIN PDM_OEE_DB.RAW.ASSET_MASTER am ON fm.ASSET_ID = am.ASSET_ID WHERE fm.WO_TYPE IN ('CORRECTIVE','EMERGENCY') GROUP BY am.TURBINE_ID, am.WIND_FARM ORDER BY total_downtime_hours DESC LIMIT 10
queries.correspondingQuestion: Which turbine had the most downtime last week?

queries.sqlText: SELECT AVG(oee.OEE) AS avg_oee FROM PDM_OEE_DB.GOLD.GOLD_OEE_METRICS oee WHERE oee.SUBSYSTEM = 'GEARBOX'
queries.correspondingQuestion: What is the average OEE for gearboxes across the fleet?

queries.sqlText: SELECT aq.ASSET_ID, aq.CONFIDENCE, aq.PRIORITY, aq.STATUS, aq.DRIVING_SIGNAL, aq.PREDICTED_FAILURE_TS FROM PDM_OEE_DB.GOLD.ALERT_QUEUE aq WHERE aq.PRIORITY >= 70 ORDER BY aq.PRIORITY DESC
queries.correspondingQuestion: Show me all high-priority alerts from the last 3 days

queries.sqlText: SELECT am.WIND_FARM, AVG(fm.ASSET_MTBF_HOURS) AS avg_mtbf FROM PDM_OEE_DB.GOLD.FLEET_METRICS fm JOIN PDM_OEE_DB.RAW.ASSET_MASTER am ON fm.ASSET_ID = am.ASSET_ID WHERE fm.WO_TYPE IN ('CORRECTIVE','EMERGENCY') GROUP BY am.WIND_FARM ORDER BY avg_mtbf ASC
queries.correspondingQuestion: Which wind farm has the worst MTBF?

queries.sqlText: SELECT oee.SHIFT_DATE, oee.SHIFT, oee.OEE, oee.AVAILABILITY, oee.PERFORMANCE, oee.QUALITY FROM PDM_OEE_DB.GOLD.GOLD_OEE_METRICS oee WHERE oee.TURBINE_ID = 'WF01-T01' AND oee.SUBSYSTEM = 'GEARBOX' ORDER BY oee.SHIFT_DATE DESC, oee.SHIFT LIMIT 10
queries.correspondingQuestion: What is the current OEE for turbine WF01-T01?

queries.sqlText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS needs_review_count FROM PDM_OEE_DB.GOLD.ALERT_QUEUE aq WHERE aq.STATUS = 'NEEDS_REVIEW'
queries.correspondingQuestion: How many alerts are in NEEDS_REVIEW status right now?

queries.sqlText: SELECT am.SUBSYSTEM, COUNT(fm.WO_ID) AS failure_count FROM PDM_OEE_DB.GOLD.FLEET_METRICS fm JOIN PDM_OEE_DB.RAW.ASSET_MASTER am ON fm.ASSET_ID = am.ASSET_ID WHERE fm.WO_TYPE IN ('CORRECTIVE','EMERGENCY') GROUP BY am.SUBSYSTEM ORDER BY failure_count DESC
queries.correspondingQuestion: Which subsystem type has the most failures?

queries.sqlText: SELECT SUM(fm.COST) AS total_cost FROM PDM_OEE_DB.GOLD.FLEET_METRICS fm WHERE fm.WO_TYPE IN ('CORRECTIVE','EMERGENCY')
queries.correspondingQuestion: What is the total estimated maintenance cost this month?

queries.sqlText: SELECT am.SUBSYSTEM, ROUND(AVG(fm.ASSET_MTTR_HOURS),1) AS avg_mttr_hours FROM PDM_OEE_DB.GOLD.FLEET_METRICS fm JOIN PDM_OEE_DB.RAW.ASSET_MASTER am ON fm.ASSET_ID = am.ASSET_ID WHERE fm.WO_TYPE IN ('CORRECTIVE','EMERGENCY') GROUP BY am.SUBSYSTEM ORDER BY avg_mttr_hours DESC
queries.correspondingQuestion: What is the average repair time by subsystem?

queries.sqlText: SELECT aq.ASSET_ID, aq.CONFIDENCE, aq.STATUS, aq.DRIVING_SIGNAL, am.SUBSYSTEM, am.WIND_FARM FROM PDM_OEE_DB.GOLD.ALERT_QUEUE aq JOIN PDM_OEE_DB.RAW.ASSET_MASTER am ON aq.ASSET_ID = am.ASSET_ID WHERE aq.STATUS = 'AUTO_ELIGIBLE' ORDER BY aq.CONFIDENCE DESC
queries.correspondingQuestion: Which assets are auto-eligible for work order creation?

queries.sqlText: SELECT oee.WIND_FARM, oee.SHIFT_DATE, ROUND(AVG(oee.OEE),3) AS daily_oee FROM PDM_OEE_DB.GOLD.GOLD_OEE_METRICS oee GROUP BY oee.WIND_FARM, oee.SHIFT_DATE ORDER BY oee.WIND_FARM, oee.SHIFT_DATE
queries.correspondingQuestion: Show me the daily OEE trend by wind farm

json_proto.semanticDescription: Predictive Maintenance and OEE Command Center for a wind turbine fleet. Contains OEE metrics per asset per shift, work order history with MTBF/MTTR/cost analytics, and ML-scored alerts with confidence and priority for failure prediction. Covers 50 subsystem assets across 10 turbines in 3 wind farms.
